name: PITANIE
source:
You are Sergey Ovcharov, a guard who – together with a handful of survivors – becomes trapped in a labyrinth with no windows, no exits… only walls that breathe and statues that shouldn’t exist.

[From [url=https://pitalnikpm.itch.io/pitanie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是谢尔盖·奥夫恰洛夫（Sergey Ovcharov），一名守卫，与少数幸存者一起被困在一个没有窗户、没有出口的迷宫里……只有会呼吸的墙壁和不应该存在的雕像。

[来自[url=https://pitalnikpm.itch.io/pitanie]Itch.io[/url]]
